messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: routing.contbatch.tail_latency p99 > 2s for 5m in us-west-2. Trigger: SLO breach. Notifying on-call.

alex wong: saw this spike ~06:05 UTC, p95 jumped from ~110ms -> 420ms, p99 ~2.9s. Streaming stalls reported in traces.

jamie li: confirmed — traces show long queuing inside continuous-batching scheduler. Mixed seq-len workloads spiking batch formation time.

sara patel: any customer-facing errors? I see a handful of 524 timeouts from proxy logs, maybe upstream timeouts at 30s. Only 3 unique api-keys so far. Opening a support ticket.

infra-bot: Quick snapshot: contbatch-scheduler cpu 85%, backlog queue depth 463, avg batch wait 680ms, streaming-forwarder goroutines blocking on kv-cache lookup.

alex wong: root cause hypothesis: mixed sequence lengths + aggressive batching window -> long per-batch wait for tail short requests (fairness issue). Also streaming requests get stuck waiting for full batch and stall.

jamie li: mitigation options: 1) reduce max batch wait (window) 2) enable streaming-priority preemption (shed non-streaming into separate pool) 3) fallback to small-model variant for affected routes.

sara patel: escalate to product if customers impacted. I've created ticket SR-8732 and notified AE.

alex wong: quick tests: lowering batch window from 50ms -> 10ms reduces avg wait in dev sim. Want to roll to canary in us-west-2.

infra-bot: canary deploy plan: toggle feature flag `contbatch_dynamic_window` for region us-west-2 on 10% fraction. Command:```curl -X POST https://ops-api/_flags -d '{"flag":"contbatch_dynamic_window","region":"us-west-2","percent":10}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN'```

jamie li: doing a hot rollback-safe mitigation first: create isolated queue for streaming traffic (priority queue) so streaming doesn't wait for large batched requests. I'll patch routing with small change, then scale scheduler down/up to pick update.

miguel ramos: I'm going to run the small quick fix: reduce `max_batch_delay_ms` to 8ms and bump `stream_priority` weight in scheduler config. Executing now.

alex wong: command I ran on leader scheduler:```kubectl -n infra exec deploy/contbatch-scheduler -- /bin/sh -c "jq '.max_batch_delay_ms=8 | .stream_priority=200' /etc/contbatch/config.json > /tmp/c && mv /tmp/c /etc/contbatch/config.json && supervisorctl restart contbatch-scheduler"```

infra-bot: restart acknowledged. New scheduler PID 17234. Observability: batch wait -> 120ms within 90s, p95 pipeline latency ~150ms (pre-change 420ms).

sara patel: support: SR-8732 logged, customers notified that we're investigating and mitigation in progress. No data leak.

jamie li: I see streaming stall counts drop quickly. However, non-streaming throughput slightly reduced — tradeoff expected. Need to tune fairness weights more gracefully.

alex wong: can we also enable prefix KV caching eviction policy to favor hot keys? That will reduce KV lookup contention which was seen in traces.

miguel ramos: enabling cache policy now:```redis-cli -h kv-cache -n 1 CONFIG SET maxmemory-policy volatile-lfu``` will prefer recently used keys. Pushing change to staging then prod.

infra-bot: cache policy update pushed to us-west-2. Eviction rate increased briefly then stabilized. KV latency 95th dropped from 45ms -> 9ms.

jamie li: final observation: p99 still has occasional spikes at ~1.6s but below alert threshold. We'll keep the contbatch_dynamic_window canary disabled until we stabilize fairness.

sara patel: customers: two had timeouts for a single request each, support ticket updated. AE emailed customers about mitigation and ETA for full resolution.

alex wong: running longer-term followups: 1) add adaptive batching that considers sequence-length histograms, 2) implement streaming preemptive slots so streaming never waits > 10ms, 3) perf test mixed workloads end-to-end.

miguel ramos: I'm taking handoff for the next 4 hours to monitor. Will run smoke-checks every 15m and coordinate with infra if p99 > 1.5s.

sara patel: thanks — passing to miguel. I'm updating the incident doc.

incident-bot: Handoff recorded: incident -> miguel ramos at 06:18 UTC. Current state: mitigations applied (reduced batch delay, cache policy), p95 ~150ms, p99 ~600-1600ms intermittently, customer impact limited to 3 timeouts, ticket SR-8732 linked.

miguel ramos: quick checklist I'm following: `observability dashboard`, `tail logs contbatch-scheduler`, `support ticket queue`, `canary flags`. If p99 crosses 2s again I'll trigger emergency rollback to `scheduler-v1` and revert config.

jamie li: notes for postmortem: include seq-len distribution sampling, scheduler fairness algorithm, metrics to detect early (batch wait p95), and an automated instructor to reduce batch window per-load.

alex wong: adding owners: scheduler-team for config change, runtime-team for streaming slots, devex for perf-test harness.

sara patel: closing the paging channel for now, will reopen if >2s re-alert. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
